# Open Historia

> Play an experimental AI grand-strategy game with natural-language orders, persistent campaign memory, and 20+ scenarios.


<!-- Keep in sync with robots.txt and ai.txt. -->

## Public pages

- [Open Historia — AI Grand Strategy Game](https://historia.aliveville.com/index.md): Play an experimental AI grand-strategy game with natural-language orders, persistent campaign memory, and 20+ scenarios.
- [Play Open Historia — AI Grand Strategy](https://historia.aliveville.com/play.md): Choose a scenario and command a civilization with natural-language orders in Open Historia.
- [About Open Historia — AI as the Rules Engine](https://historia.aliveville.com/about.md): Learn how Open Historia combines natural-language strategy, an AI rules engine, and rewindable timelines.
- [Privacy — Open Historia](https://historia.aliveville.com/privacy.md): How Open Historia handles sign-in identity, private saves, provider requests, and deletion.
- [Pax Historia Alternative — Free, Open-Source AI Grand Strategy](https://historia.aliveville.com/pax-historia-alternative.md): Open Historia is a free, open-source, browser-playable alternative to Pax Historia: natural-language orders, 20+ scenarios, campaign memory, and no credit meter.
